_source: Windows Excel's own automatic row heights (96-dpi pixels) for faces and sizes where officeRowHeight's metric formula is off. Defaults: the defaultRowHeight most often stated by 5,187 xlsx-rounds files written by Windows Excel (font 0, no customHeight), each pair seen in at least 5 files and in at least 45% of them (tools/rowmetric_check.py). Other sizes: the ht Windows Excel wrote for rows set in that one font alone, in workbooks whose default font it outgrows or where the row stands below the default, and n wrapped lines n times one (tools/rowfont_by_default.py, rowlines_check.py, 2026-11-13). MS Gothic, MS PGothic, MS Mincho and MS PMincho at 9, 9.5 and 10.5 pt, and the names Windows lacks that real files give with charset 128 (明朝, MS　明朝, 標準ゴシック, Osaka, 細明朝体: GDI maps them to MS Mincho), from Windows Excel's printed rows (xlsx-rounds/lookwin probes p3, p23). Small Normal fonts (5-10 pt: Calibri, Arial, Aptos Narrow, Aptos, Times New Roman, Verdana, Tahoma, Segoe UI, Cambria), Windows Excel's default row off its printed rows (lookwin p88-lw, 2026-11-15): GDI's hinted heights there are not monotonic (Times New Roman 7 is 14 px, 7.5 is 13).
